bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New features and fixes are rolling out for Windows Insiders in both Dev and Beta Channels.
Phishing Campaign Uncovered - A multi-stage AiTM phishing attack targets organizations, exploiting **SharePoint** for user compromise.
Notepad and Paint Updates - Enhancements for Notepad and Paint are now available to Windows Insiders, improving user experience.
Xbox App on Arm PCs - The **Xbox** app is now available on Arm-based Windows 11 PCs, expanding gaming accessibility.
AI Agents Security Challenges - The rise of AI agents introduces complex security risks that require comprehensive management.
AI-Powered Identity Security - Four priorities for enhancing identity and network access security in 2026 focus on AI integration.
AI Strategy with Marketplace - **Microsoft Marketplace** offers a vast catalog of AI solutions to accelerate adoption and integration.
